column6: Great lord, prominent among the gods, your judgments are clever and powerful! Father @wDN{Enki}, respected one, supreme dragon, who determines the fates firmly, who has taken his seat upon the numerous divine powers in colourful brilliance, great prince, the guardian of the gods, …… of holy @wDN{An}!

column6: @gap{2 lines fragmentary} The fates you determine are firm; you are the junior @wDN{Enlil}. You distribute the divine powers for the @wDN{Anuna}, the great gods. You establish for them a habitation, a holy dwelling place; you are their proud lord. Your greatness is unapproachable ……. You …… in a pure place the @fsux{abzu}, the mountain built with princely divine powers; …… @wSN{Eridug}, the shrine, which extends over huge marshes, marshes of snakes.

@wDN{Enki}, lord, firstborn son of @wDN{An} ……, @wDN{Nudimmud}, great bull of the @fsux{abzu} ……, may you …… with your consort, holy @wDN{Damgalnuna}. Father @wDN{Enki}, may you embrace her and soothe your heart with her. …… friendly words on behalf of @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}. …… the prayer of the king until distant days. The one blessed by @wDN{Enlil} ……, @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}, the shepherd, …… the son of @wDN{Enlil}. May his radiance …… for you to the outer limits of heaven and earth. May he have authority, may he be peerless in all the numerous countries. May @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}} …… from the south as far as the uplands. …… the god of the Land ……. May the @wWN{Tigris} and @wWN{Euphrates} ……, may they bring abundance for him. May the udders of heaven open for him; may the harvest …… for him. May barley, emmer, wheat, @fsux{gu-nida} grain …… on vast fields for him. May grain heaps be heaped up for him; may @wDN{Ezina} …….
Father @wDN{Enki}, bestow …… kingship and a reign of abundance upon @wRN{Išme-@wDN{Dagan}}.
